# Dynamics-memory **Bounded long-term memory layer for LLM agents** Distill continuous, noisy, and contradictory project interactions into a memory repository that won't pile up into a "history mountain".
In a new session, with just "let's continue", the agent knows where it progressed to and where it got stuck last time. [Architecture](#architecture-push-capture--pull-repair) · [Dynamics](#memory-dynamics) · [Verification Status](#verification-status) · [Running](#running) · [Design Document](https://github.com/1173591564/Dynamics-memory/blob/HEAD/docs/ouroboros.md) --- ## 30-second quickstart ```bash pip install numpy pytest cp .env.example .env # ZAI_API_KEY=... python -m pytest tests/ # 302 passed python -m hybrid_memory.server --project # or auto-launched by opencode plugin ``` To integrate with opencode (official CLI only, no source code required): ```bash npm i -g opencode-ai cd && opencode # .opencode/plugin/memory-bridge.ts auto-loads and launches sidecar ``` For use in other projects: symlink `memory-bridge.ts` to `/.opencode/plugin/`. Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatic collection, parsing, visualization (HTML), and automatic generation of PNG images of charts for planned/emergency power outages in Ukraine.

The project receives data from open web pages of suppliers and stores it in JSON 'as is' in the `data/` directory. Then this data is displayed in a fixed HTML template and converted to PNG images, which are stored in `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data Format

Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (shortened):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — planned power outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored 'as is', without structure normalization.
- `fact` — actual/emergency power outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

TerryTian-tech/OpenCC-Traditional-Chines.body:
# OpenCC-Traditional Chinese to Traditional Chinese (The Chinese Government Standard)
OpenCC Open Chinese Conversion - Converting mixed traditional character forms of different standards to standard traditional character forms according to the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters (2013)

[Display Documentation Page](https://terrytian-tech.github.io/OpenCC-Traditional-Chinese-characters-according-to-Chinese-government-standards/)

[Conversion Scheme Design Documentation](https://github.com/TerryTian-tech/OpenCC-Traditional-Chinese-characters-according-to-Chinese-government-standards/blob/main/doc/%E3%80%8A%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8%E8%A7%84%E8%8C%83%E6%B1%89%E5%AD%97%E8%A1%A8%E3%80%8B%E8%A7%84%E8%8C%83%E7%B9%81%E4%BD%93%E8%BD%AC%E6%8D%A2%E6%96%B9%E6%A1%88%E8%AE%BE%E8%AE%A1%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E.md)

*For discussions on traditional and simplified character conversion issues, join QQ group: 1055649831*

## Repository Introduction
In 2013, the State Council issued the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters as a supporting specification for implementing the National Common Language and Writing Law of the People's Republic of China in mainland China. This table standardized the forms of simplified characters in mainland China, while also including in "Attachment 1" the corresponding traditional character forms. Although mainland input method software and traditional-simplified conversion plugins do not completely follow this table's traditional character forms, these forms are treated as the standard for mainland traditional publications. In 2021, the Table of Standard Character Forms for Ancient Texts Printing (GB/Z 40637—2021) was released, but it has two major defects: first, it has not established separate lists of standard characters and variant characters, instead recording all standard and variant forms together in the character form table; second, some character forms from the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters are not included in the Ancient Texts Printing table, while that table only has the status of a "normative technical document," which has lower legal authority than the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters. Therefore, the Ancient Texts Printing table has not been widely promoted, and traditional publications continue to base their character forms on adjustments to the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters.

The "Explanation" section in Attachment 1 of the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters, "Comparison Table of Standard Characters, Traditional Characters, and Variant Characters," states:

>The compilation of this table is intended to guide the correct use of the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters, facilitate reading of classical texts, and promote communication between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait and the Hong Kong and Macau regions. The use of traditional characters and variant characters shall follow the provisions of the National Common Language and Writing Law of the People's Republic of China. …

# 🪪 Hong Kong Immigration Department Appointment Quota Monitor

Real-time tracking of Hong Kong Immigration Department **ID Card Renewal** appointment quotas, with automatic notifications in **Feishu groups + Feishu private chats** when new quotas are released.

---

## 📱 Method 1: Join Feishu Group (Recommended)

Bot automatically pushes quota changes, **instant message delivery**, join and use immediately, no configuration needed.

> 📖 **[Group Info & How to Join](https://scn7uo58gnuo.feishu.cn/wiki/QSFlwcMBmil7sGkZRBTcAWqwnCf)** (Multiple group solutions, automatic load balancing when group is full)

### 💬 Method 2: Feishu Private Chat Subscription

If you don't want to join a group, you can also **filter by date**, only receiving notifications for dates you're interested in:

1. [Private chat with bot "HKID Quota Auto-Monitor"](https://applink.feishu.cn/T98uc8RbxI8c) (send any message to trigger)
2. The bot will reply with an interactive card supporting:
   - 📅 **Subscribe to Specific Dates** — only focus on your appointment date
   - 🔔 **Subscribe to All Dates** — all quota releases are notified
   - 📊 **View / Modify / Cancel Subscription**
3. You can also reply with dates directly for one-click subscription, e.g., `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Three filter modes are supported:
- 📅 **By Date** — only see specific dates, unlimited immigration offices
- 🏢 **By Immigration Office** — only see specific offices, unlimited dates
- 🎯 **By Date + Immigration Office** — exact match

> 💡 Private chat with the bot has a 1-2 second delay; if you're in a hurry, we recommend joining the group.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status for all Hong Kong offices
- 📈 Quota release pattern heatmap, visualizing quota release frequency across time periods
- 📖 Includes phone appointment tutorial
- 🔧 Built-in admin backend supporting subscriber management, statistics overview, dual-channel broadcast

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quotas are detected, they are pushed in the following order:

> **Group Chat Broadcast** (multiple groups in parallel) → **Private Chat DM** (in parallel, only pushed to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu groups and private chats arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy and Security

- Feishu user data is stored with **AES-256-GCM encryption**, unreadable in the repository
- Only reads quota data **publicly released** by Immigration Department
- ⚠️ Disclaimer: This system is a third-party open-source tool, not an official service of Hong Kong Immigration Department; please refer to official website information.

leizongmin/ZeroWeb.body:
# ZeroWeb

ZeroWeb is an experimental cross-platform browser project written in Rust. This repository is doing two things at the same time:

Official website: [zeroweb.leizm.com](https://zeroweb.leizm.com)

- An embeddable and reusable `ZeroWebView` library
- A complete `ZeroBrowser` browser application

The project's main line tries to keep the core code and dependency boundaries in its own hands, so the page kernel is mainly built up gradually from Rust components with permissive licenses. DOM, CSS, layout, rendering, navigation, and security boundaries are all added layer by layer in this repository.

This is also an AI-first engineering experiment: humans are only responsible for architecture design, key decisions, and result verification, with code development almost entirely completed independently by AI. We want to see how far AI can push this kind of complex system under the premise that architecture boundaries, tests, and acceptance criteria are all written clearly.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This repository is still in the experimental phase, mainly used for learning, research, and engineering exploration. The core crate and tests already have quite a lot of content, but the browser shell, complete page JavaScript runtime, and real site compatibility are still on the roadmap. It is not a browser for everyday use right now. For commercial or other production use, please evaluate the risks of functionality, security, compatibility, performance, and license boundaries on your own.

**Quick Navigation**

- [Roadmap](https://github.com/leizongmin/ZeroWeb/blob/HEAD/ROADMAP.md)
- [Official Website](https://zeroweb.leizm.com)
- [Current Status](#current-status)
- [Quick Start](#quick-start)
- [Repository Structure](#repository-structure)
- [Documentation Navigation](#documentation-navigation)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Project Positioning

- **Embedding First**: In addition to the browser application, the project must deliver a stable Rust `ZeroWebView` API for other applications to integrate directly.
- **License Boundary First**: The main line dependencies prioritize permissive licenses such as MIT, Apache-2.0, and BSD to avoid core capabilities being constrained by unsuitable copyleft dependencies.
- **Full-Stack Rust Route**: The page kernel, host layer, and rendering infrastructure all try to be completed within the Rust ecosystem.
- **AI can write, but must be reviewable**: AI-assisted contributions are welcome, but submitted changes must be clearly explained, thoroughly tested, and easily reviewed.

qinxujunai/VoiceFlow.body:
# VoiceFlow Simplified Chinese · English

> Open your mouth, text is in place. VoiceFlow is an offline voice input tool on Windows. Press `F2` once to start, press again to finish; no need to switch applications, voice becomes text on this machine, results return to the current cursor. ## Why VoiceFlow - **Completely offline**: no account needed, recordings not uploaded; dictation works normally even when offline. - **Common input boxes**: attempts automatic paste in regular applications; preserves clipboard when permissions or targets are restricted. - **Delivery fallback**: if paste doesn't land in input box, can be recovered from clipboard or history; preserves temporary recovery recording and prompts failure when copy is blocked. - **Complete recording priority**: the capsule is only responsible for real-time feedback; generates final results based on complete recording after stopping. ## Download Download the latest Windows installer from [GitHub Latest Release](https://github.com/qinxujunai/VoiceFlow/releases/latest). The installer already includes the default offline model, no Python needed, ready to use after installation. System requirements: Windows 10 / 11 x64, available microphone. ### Updates and Local Data VoiceFlow does not connect to the internet in the background or perform silent updates. To upgrade, open settings from the tray menu, go to "About VoiceFlow" and click "Check for Updates"; the download link is only displayed when GitHub Release simultaneously provides a matching version installer and `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and each item in the verification file matches the GitHub digest of the installer. Upgrading by running the installer will not delete configuration, dictionary, and models in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VoiceFlow`. "Clear local data" on the history page only deletes local dictation history and undelivered recordings after confirmation when there are no dictation or recovery operations, and will not delete these settings. ## Usage | Key | Behavior | | --- | --- | | `F2` | Start / Stop voice input | | `Right Ctrl` | Start / Stop voice input | | `xbutton1` / `xbutton2` | Start / Stop with mouse side buttons | | `Esc` | Cancel current recording, no text output | Normal output path: ```text Speaking → Local recognition → Text cleanup → Clipboard → Current cursor → Local history ``` ## Privacy and Internet Connection Recordings, transcriptions, dictionaries, and history are saved only on this machine by default. The installer does not include dictation history from the developer or other users; the history page allows deleting individual records or clearing all. During normal operation, models are not automatically downloaded, updates are not checked, or cloud recognition services are not called. In source code mode, internet connection only occurs when the user explicitly prepares models.

# Tiangong（天工）

> Plugin-centric personal AI Agent host: the main program handles Agent loops, model integration, plugin runtime and sandbox, with capabilities like file access, command execution, browser control, desktop manipulation, memory, multi-agent collaboration, and scheduled tasks all provided by plugins.

Tiangong is a personal intelligent terminal built with Rust, Tauri, and [silent](https://github.com/silent-rs/silent), with desktop application as the core form, while also providing CLI and Server and other interface-free operation modes to integrate scripts, services, or external message channels. The main program itself only retains the universal framework: conversation and ReAct loops, model Provider, plugin registration and routing, permissions and sandbox boundaries, desktop interface and extension mounting points, as well as Bot hosting, Webhook and other external access channels; what the Agent can do depends on which plugins are installed and enabled.

Official plugins cover the main capabilities needed for daily work: file read/write, command and terminal execution, embedded browser operation, launching and controlling desktop applications, long-term memory, persistent Subagent collaboration, scheduled and triggered tasks, etc. Plugins can also declare tools to the Agent and contribute interfaces to users, allowing humans and the Agent to collaborate in the same working environment; users can also create their own plugins directly within Tiangong.

> **Highly recommend installing the three plugins: Computer Use, Embedded Browser, and Embedded Terminal**, where **Computer Use** allows the Agent to directly operate WeChat, Feishu, system settings, and any other desktop applications - this is the most worthwhile capability to experience in Tiangong (currently fully available on macOS and Windows, with limited Linux support). See [Highly Recommended Plugins](#强烈推荐的插件).

Model integration is provided by the main program: supporting DeepSeek's context caching mechanism and V4 new interface (`deepseek-v4-pro` / `deepseek-v4-flash`), supporting thinking mode tiers, dual-channel structured and text protocol tool call parsing, and streaming KV cache hit rate statistics; supporting login with ChatGPT accounts (Codex OAuth) to directly call GPT series models without needing an API Key; switch models anytime within a conversation with automatic context organization before switching. Recommended to use [DeepSeek](https://www.deepseek.com/), [Kimi](https://kimi.com/), [Zhipu](https://www.bigmodel.cn/), and ChatGPT, other models can be integrated through custom providers (supporting OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic protocols).

> Security note: Tiangong by default isolates plugin Sidecars and on-demand command processes through an independent Sandbox Launcher. The Launcher uses macOS Seatbelt, Linux bubblewrap, Windows AppContainer and Job Object respectively…

zhengshukeji/lava.description: Lava — Make Java infrastructure development simpler, safer, and more consistent
zhengshukeji/lava.body:
# Lava

Lava is a modular infrastructure toolkit for Java 25, providing Java applications with ID, retry, bounded IO, JSON, HTTP/SSE, payment channel protocols, in-process scheduling, cryptography, and email capabilities.
Each module can be used independently without dependence on Spring or other application frameworks, applicable to backend services, command-line tools, and standalone Java applications.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/zhengshuyuncom/lava)
- [Issues](https://github.com/zhengshuyuncom/lava/issues)

## Modules

| Module                                       | Main Capabilities                                                  |
|--------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| [`lava-bom`](https://github.com/zhengshukeji/lava/blob/HEAD/lava-bom/README.md)           | Unified version management for all Lava modules                                |
| [`lava-core`](https://github.com/zhengshukeji/lava/blob/HEAD/lava-core/README.md)         | UUIDv7, Snowflake, retry, bounded IO, time, parameter validation, and client IP |
| [`lava-json`](https://github.com/zhengshukeji/lava/blob/HEAD/lava-json/README.md)         | Thread-safe JSON encoding/decoding based on Jackson 3                     |
| [`lava-http`](https://github.com/zhengshukeji/lava/blob/HEAD/lava-http/README.md)         | HTTP client based on OkHttp 5, streaming responses, and SSE              |
| [`lava-pay-wechat`](https://github.com/zhengshukeji/lava/blob/HEAD/lava-pay-wechat/README.md) | WeChat Pay API v3 protocol adaptation, no dependency on WeChat official SDK          |
|…
